Process Notes

Word Target: 249 words

Constraint: Univocalic (only ‘I’)

A univocalic poem uses only the vowel ‘i’. Christian Bök’s ‘Eunoia’ dedicates chapters to each vowel.

Instruction: Write using only the vowel ‘i’. Avoid: a, e, o, u.

Mode: Exquisite Corpse

Write between the revealed fragments. Subsequent fragments will be revealed as you progress.

Prompt

A novel that cannot be finished because finishing would destroy it.
